compiled_state.title: As a bridge operator, I want a fetcher/differ/applier pipeline that excludes reconciler-owned fields from diff input, so that the reconciler is idempotent on a converged state.
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Core reconciler pipeline. Fetcher pulls normalized state. Differ computes mutations excluding reconciler-owned fields. Applier executes and writes per-pass manifest. split_candidate evaluated and dismissed in Phase F: applier cannot satisfy sc-4 independently; implementation stages internally via TDD iterations.

## Done Definitions
- Fetcher produces normalized snapshot at bridge_state/snapshots/<pass>.json ← Satisfies: sc-4
- Differ produces mutation list with reconciler-owned fields excluded; per-pass manifest enumerates every planned mutation ← Satisfies: sc-4
- Two consecutive reconciler passes on a converged state produce manifests with mutation count = 0 ← Satisfies: sc-4

## Considerations
- [Testability] Excluded-field list must be a single configuration value for test verification.
- [Architecture] Manifest format shared between bootstrap and steady-state.
- [Performance] At current scale (1,482+ issues), fetcher produces O(N) REST calls per pass. Stakeholder input needed on whether Jira pagination cursors are stable across calls in the target environment before cursor-caching optimization is designed — NEEDS_HUMAN from blue-team review.

## Escalation Policy
Escalate when blocked
